newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIAN TRADE MIXED, STABILITY SEEN.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIAN TRADE MIXED, STABILITY SEEN.

text.p: Lithuania's market showed signs of stabilisation on Tuesday after steadily falling in recent weeks, dealers said.
"Today ten shares advanced, seven fell and eleven remained unchanged in group A ," Arvydas Jacikevichius with Suprema brokerage house told Reuters.
"The supply of shares rose on the bourse today but it did not cause prices to fall and I think this is the first sign of stabilisation on the market," Jacikevichius added.
He also said he expected the bourse's indices to advance for the third straight session, though they could be weighed down by a 3.19 percent drop in Lithuanian Energy to 2.43 litas.
Most other blue chips remained unchanged, with Lithuanian Gas holding steady at 1.80 litas, Birzai Dairy at 10.25 litas, Kalnapilis at 5.50 litas and the Lithuanian Sea Shipping compay at 6.50 litas.
Dealers were not suprised by the gain made by Rokishkis Cheese, which advanced to 43.50 litas from 43.00 litas.
The banking sector saw Savings Bank ease to 260.00 litas from 268.00 litas while other banking shares either stayed stable or their prices were not set yet.
